RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so an all-female panel selecting one woman over another provides no plausible basis for sex discrimination. Raising the panel’s gender composition would appear unfounded and could significantly damage your professional reputation.

For a laboratory head role, institutions often prioritize formal management training and broad operational leadership over advanced academic credentials like a PhD. Additionally, a two-week delay in written feedback is routine in hospital bureaucracy. 

Instead of questioning the panel's makeup, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how you can strengthen your leadership profile for future executive opportunities. Focus entirely on qualifications, competencies, and fit.
